0: Find your start level: 1 after a Heroic or Racial TR, 20 after an Epic Reincarnation (unverified), 15 in Iconic (see chapter 3).
Lives 2 to 4 need about 1,900,000 XP to reach level 20. Later lives need more (see 3.2).
Whether Elite and Reaper open right away depends on your access and reincarnations (rule in 2.3).
2: Open every quest on Reaper from the first run, with VIP or at least 2 reincarnations, except quests with no Reaper, for +45% first-time and +150% delving.
Drink a Sovereign elixir for +50% XP. Sovereign I lasts 3 hours and Sovereign II lasts 6 hours. The timer only runs while you are in a quest.
Equip a single XP item, for example Voice of the Master at +5%, and drink an elixir on top. The two stack.
Play your Daily as your first run of the day for +25% in Heroic and +40% in Epic. It is available 18 hours after the last completion.
Avoid replaying a quest: each repeat gives 20% less XP (floor of 20%), and the penalty is halved every 18 hours.
3: After a Heroic or Racial TR, you restart at level 1 and follow the route up to level 36.
After an Epic Reincarnation you restart at level 20 (unverified, check in game). After an Iconic TR you restart at level 15 (confirmed).
From level 1 to 20, plan on 1,900,000 XP on lives 2 to 4, 2,850,000 on lives 5 to 7, and 3,800,000 from life 8 on.
Once your character has earned its 12,600,000 Legendary XP, 30 to 36 is instant on every later life.
From level 20 to 30, plan on 8,250,000 XP, a figure that is unverified after U81.
4: With VIP or 2 reincarnations, open each quest once on Elite or Reaper for the +45% first-time bonus and up to +150% delving bonus.
Stay at most 2 levels above a quest's base level to keep the full delving bonus.
Keep Heroic sagas unturned only if a Lesser or Epic Reincarnation follows. Before a True or Racial Reincarnation, turn them in.
Playing Reaper, skip Korthos, Tangleroot Gorge and the solo quests, which have no Reaper.
VIP players can follow Vooduspyce's level 1-20 guide (before U81). F2P players follow the Sepulchre Gaming series.
5: At 15, play Myth Drannor or the Gianthold walk-ups. At 16, play the rest of Gianthold, Subversion and Litany of the Dead.
At 17, play Sharn 1, then Cogs. At 18, play Sharn 2.
Stay at most 2 levels above a quest's base level, or the delving bonus is halved.
Between 18 and 20, drink an XP elixir, then turn in sagas (wiki, not cross-checked).
Without a paid pack, play the free list from Dinosaur Crisis (13) to Kill Ten Rats (18).
6: Play the Epic quests from the lowest to the highest quest level, and fill the Epic sagas without turning them in.
Drink your best elixir, for example Sovereign II (+50% for 6 hours), and wear one XP item before turning in your sagas (wiki, not cross-checked).
Take your levels between saga turn-ins, since the XP bank cap is 2 levels (exactly one level's XP at levels 20 and 30).
Run the Tokens of the Twelve quests on Elite or Reaper, since 20 Tokens of the Twelve buy a Heroic True Heart of Wood or of Blood from Lahar.
7: From level 30, only Legendary quests with a base level of 30 or more give Legendary XP.
Level 36 takes 12,600,000 Legendary XP. You earn it only once per character, because this XP is never lost.
After your first Legendary life, every life that reaches level 30 jumps straight to your highest Legendary level.
To play free, use Temple of Elemental Evil Part One (30, unverified) and the three Lordsmarch quests at level 34 (Frame Work, Diplomatic Impunity, Eyes of Stone).
Aim for the Very Long level 35 to 37 quests in Reaper: 394 to 410.8 RXP per skull, with Relentless and Snowfall and Sunlight at 402.4.
8: At level 30+, run the Legendary quests with the most RXP per skull in Reaper, in a party at R4 or higher.
The first Reaper run of each quest in a life is worth triple, so vary your quests.
Pick even skulls (R4, R6, R8, R10), and stay below a skull that doubles the run time.
Spend your first points on Grim Barricade, then aim for 40 to 50 points before the Racial lives.
Doom's skull threshold (R5 or R7) is unverified, so expect it from R5.
9: Enter Iconic with an Iconic True Heart of Wood (1,495 DDO Points) and level from 15 to 20. Entering from a non-Iconic life is unconfirmed.
At level 30, jump to the cap and run the Legendary quests in Reaper. The first run gives +200% Reaper XP (wiki, not cross-checked).
Take an Epic Reincarnation (1,295 DDO Points or 4,200 Commendations), turn in the sagas, then do the Iconic TR.
Pick the class of each Iconic life to work toward the Heroic Completionist, one past life in each of the 15 classes.
Wait on Racial lives until you have the Heroic Completionist, about two dozen Epic Past Lives and 40-50 Reaper Points.
10: Follow the 6 steps in order on every life; after an Epic Reincarnation, restart at step 3.
Keep 20 Tokens of the Twelve for the next heart.
From 20 to 30, count 8,250,000 XP per life (a 2015 figure, unverified after U81), then 12,600,000 Legendary XP once per character.
At the cap, run the life's Legendary quests on Reaper before the next TR (golden rule 8).
11: Check in game whether Legendary quests give Commendations of Valor, since players contradict each other and no source settles it.
Test in game how XP elixirs and items stack, since the Compendium is silent and only the wiki describes a queue (not cross-checked).
The Epic XP table for 20 to 30 and the route for levels 1-15 are unverified after U81. No official XP change is listed from U81 to U82.1.
Keep Axel's order for the reincarnations (Axel's DDO Channel on YouTube, source AX), since no 2026 opinion found contradicts it.
12: Each source in the text has a tag such as AX or R167. Look it up in this chapter to see the title, link and date.
The sources are grouped into closed sections: first version, Compendium pages, release notes, forum threads, and wiki and guides.
"Wiki, not cross-checked" means one ddowiki page read once, with no second source.
Research was done on Nov 5, 2026 by three AI agents (Sonnet), then cross-checked by hand on ddowiki.
